scope: live solar and battery-storage projects in the DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 spine (not operational, refused, withdrawn or abandoned)

calibration.method: median of observed planning_permission_granted -> under_construction intervals, per technology and capacity band
calibration.fallback: bands with n < 30 use the technology median

band_note.EARLY: Consented, and early in the window comparable projects take to reach construction. Specification decisions are still open.
band_note.LATE: Consented and further through that window. Specification is closing.
band_note.BEYOND: Consented longer ago than comparable projects took to start building. Either moving quietly or waiting on something - worth a call either way.
band_note.BUILDING: The planning register records construction under way.
band_note.NOT_CURRENT: As published by DESNZ, the planning register does not show a live permission for this site. That is the register speaking, not us.
band_note.NO_DATE: Permission granted; no consent date published yet.
band_note.UNCLASSIFIED: Not enough published dates to place this one.

caveat.distance: Straight-line distance to a mapped feature - a screen, not a connection route.
caveat.lead: Median of observed consent-to-construction intervals published by DESNZ, per technology and size band.
caveat.binding: Whether a company name can be matched to this project at all.
caveat.corroboration: Register confirmation is added as the planning and company feeds come online.
